key_concepts: Chromosomes carry genetic information in the form of DNA
Genes are the basic units of heredity that determine traits
DNA carries codes passed from parents to offspring and determines traits
DNA is a polymer made of repeating monomers called nucleotides
A nucleotide has three components: deoxyribose sugar, phosphate, and a nitrogenous base
The DNA molecule is a double helix shaped like a twisted ladder
The DNA backbone is made of alternating deoxyribose sugar and phosphate molecules
The four nitrogenous bases in DNA are adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine
Adenine pairs only with thymine and guanine pairs only with cytosine
The order of nitrogenous bases along a DNA strand encodes genetic instructions
Watson and Crick are credited with establishing the structure of DNA in 1953
Chargaff's rule states DNA has equal amounts of adenine and thymine and equal amounts of g
